label: Ink & Watercolor
description: Expressive ink lines and transparent washes; suited to atmospheric journeys and intimate observation.
rendering: A complete scene in loose pen-and-ink and transparent watercolor washes, with expressive lines and airy light. Painted scenery fills the whole image, continuing beyond all four edges.
palette: Transparent washes of ochre, sienna, indigo and sage; luminous lights.
lighting: Bright, airy light; shadows as cool layered washes.
materials: Confident ink linework, wet-in-wet blooms and granulating pigment within the depicted world.
composition: Detail concentrated on key subjects; softer, fully painted surroundings extend through every corner.
negatives: Washes, pigment and scenery must reach every edge. No white or cream paper margins, unpainted corners, paper edges, sketchbook, tape, border or vignette. Do not present the scene on a sheet of paper or against a blank backdrop. Avoid photorealism, digital airbrush smoothness and cartoon caricature.
